hyperedges.label: Single-Page Scroll Layout Pattern
hyperedges.description: Index page composes all section components; Navigation and Footer both link to section anchors; smooth-scroll behavior ties UI together into a SPA scroll experience.

hyperedges.label: Build & Deploy Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Vite builds the app, postbuild injects banner and 404.html, gh-pages deploys to GitHub Pages, vercel.json handles SPA routing for Vercel deployments.

hyperedges.label: Design System (Tailwind + Radix + shadcn)
hyperedges.description: shadcn/ui wraps Radix UI primitives, Tailwind provides utility CSS processed by PostCSS, all configured together as the app's design system.

nodes.label: index.html (App Entry)
nodes.rationale: Root HTML entry; sets page title 'Manus Nova - Student-Led Prosthetics Innovation' and loads src/main.tsx as module

nodes.label: Hero Prosthetics Image
nodes.rationale: Medical/clinical setting showing a robotic prosthetic hand being examined by healthcare professionals in surgical scrubs; used as hero banner to convey prosthetics innovation mission

nodes.label: Manus Nova Logo
nodes.rationale: Circular logo with two hands reaching toward each other (one human, one prosthetic/darker) on a pink/mauve background; text reads 'MANUS NOVA' (top arc) and 'A HELPING HAND' (bottom arc); dark navy and pink color palette; symbolizes human connection and prosthetics assistance
